about: Three local operations over coordinates, and no edge anywhere: within (a point refines a region), resolution (how
finely a place is named) and passes (the coordinate goes through this step). Exclusivity is what no other side
reaches, and a region no point reaches contracts (L20) — vacuity read as geometry rather than run as a rule.
The three came from six definitions that had drifted: one counted a dot as a step and another did not, and one was
not refinement at all. With one definition and this vector, two acts that paid an unreachable region stopped

cases.name: resolution is the count of steps
exclusive keeps what no other side reaches
a side with no coordinate of its own contracts
passes through a step at any resolution
a step that is not there
a star names an ending of one step
an ending is not a whole step
a scope steps on dots as well as slashes
a longer name is not a coarser one

coverage.criterion: each question a coordinate answers once — within (fine, sibling, itself, dotted steps, a prefix that is not a step), resolution (plain, a star), exclusive, contracts (untouched, touched, empty side), passes (a step, a missing step, an ending, an ending that is not a step)
coverage.why: hand-written over names; the wildcard runs are pinned in region.json, not here
